clauses.text:
1. An application has been duly made, pursuant to and in full compliance with the

provisions of title I of the National Industrial Recovery Act, approved June 16, 1933,
for my approval of a Code of Fair Competition for the Southern Rice Milling Industry ;

and,

source.page_or_item: Executive_Orders_6251-6479.djvu; scanned pages 486-487; closing number tag 6441A

clauses.text:
2. Due notice and opportunity for hearings to interested parties has been given

pursuant to the provisions of the act and regulations thereunder; and,

clauses.text:
3. Hearings have been held upon said code, pursuant to such notice and pursuant
to the pertinent provisions of the act and regulations thereunder; and,

source.page_or_item: Executive_Orders_6251-6479.djvu; scanned pages 486-487; closing number tag 6441A

clauses.text:
4. Said code of fair competition constitutes a code of fair competition, as con-
templated by the act and complies in all respects with the pertinent provisions of
the act, including clauses (1) and (2) of subsection (a) of section 3 of title I of the

act; and,

source.page_or_item: Executive_Orders_6251-6479.djvu; scanned pages 486-487; closing number tag 6441A

clauses.text:
5. It appears, after due consideration, that said code of fair competition will
tend to effectuate the policy of Congress as declared in section 1 of title I of the act.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, Franklin D. Roosevelt, President of the United States,
pursuant to the authority vested in me by title I of the National Industrial Recovery
Act, approved June 16, 1933, and otherwise, do hereby approve said Code of Fair

Competition for the Southern Rice Milling Industry.

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT,
President of the United States.

Tue Waite House,
November 21, 1983.

[No. 6441-A]

APPROVAL OF CODE OF Fair COMPETITION FOR THE SOUTHERN RICE
MILLING INDUSTRY

WHEREAS the Secretary of Agriculture and the National Recovery Adminis-
trator having submitted for my approval a Code of Fair Competition for the Southern
Rice Milling Industry and having rendered their separate reports and recommenda-
tions and findings thereon:

NOW, THEREFORE, I, Franklin D. Roosevelt, President of the United States,
pursuant to the authority vested in me by title I of the National Industrial Recovery
Act, approved June 16, 1933, and otherwise, do hereby find that:

1. An application has been duly made, pursuant to and in full compliance with the

provisions of title I of the National Industrial Recovery Act, approved June 16, 1933,
for my approval of a Code of Fair Competition for the Southern Rice Milling Industry ;

and,
2. Due notice and opportunity for hearings to interested parties has been given

pursuant to the provisions of the act and regulations thereunder; and,

3. Hearings have been held upon said code, pursuant to such notice and pursuant
to the pertinent provisions of the act and regulations thereunder; and,

4. Said code of fair competition constitutes a code of fair competition, as con-
templated by the act and complies in all respects with the pertinent provisions of
the act, including clauses (1) and (2) of subsection (a) of section 3 of title I of the

act; and,
5. It appears, after due consideration, that said code of fair competition will
tend to effectuate the policy of Congress as declared in section 1 of title I of the act.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, Franklin D. Roosevelt, President of the United States,
pursuant to the authority vested in me by title I of the National Industrial Recovery
Act, approved June 16, 1933, and otherwise, do hereby approve said Code of Fair

Competition for the Southern Rice Milling Industry.

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT,
President of the United States.

Tue Waite House,
November 21, 1983.

[No. 6441-A]

U.S. GOVERNMENT PRINTING OFFICE: $939
